-2.23553,53.32611.state: King's Court, Water Lane, Wilmslow, Cheshire, SK9 5AR
-2.23553,53.32611.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

15.47015,47.08057.state: Medizinische Universität Graz Auenbruggerplatz 2 8036 Graz Österreich, Austria
15.47015,47.08057.desc: A BSL3+ laboratory, operational. Run by The Medical University of Graz. It is categorised as a university laboratory, working on human health. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

138.25000,36.20000.desc: Self-regulated through institutional committees and a professional society. No national count is published, so Japanese laboratory animal use is estimated from what the suppliers sell.

-2.59600,51.44900.name: Soil Association
-2.59600,51.44900.desc: Certifies organic production in the United Kingdom, and organic standards exclude engineered material outright. A grower whose crop tests positive loses the certification and the price premium with it, which is a sharper consequence than any regulator imposes for the same finding.

116.60000,40.08000.name: Biocytogen
116.60000,40.08000.state: Beijing — with US and European sites
116.60000,40.08000.desc: A Chinese company producing genetically engineered mouse models to order and running antibody discovery from them, part of the cluster of Beijing-based model-animal businesses that also includes the two already on this map. Its presence completes a picture worth seeing whole: the world's engineered laboratory mice now come substantially from a handful of firms in Beijing, Shanghai, Massachusetts, New York State and Denmark, and a strain ordered by a laboratory anywhere is likely to have been made in one of them. The crop side of this map documents four seed majors and calls it concentration. The animal side is comparable and almost never described that way.

121.04900,14.65100.name: JDC No. 1 s.2021 and DA Memorandum Circular No. 8 s.2022 — the Philippine route
121.04900,14.65100.desc: The Philippine carve-out works differently from the exemptions elsewhere on this map, and the difference is worth having. Rather than declaring a class of edits outside the rules, the 2021 Joint Department Circular of five departments — science, agriculture, environment, health and interior — states that products of new breeding innovations which do not contain novel combinations of genetic material obtained through modern biotechnology are not covered by it, and DA Memorandum Circular No. 8 of May 2022 sets out how each product is EVALUATED to determine which side of that line it falls. So there is a case-by-case determination and a body making it, where India and Australia wrote a category-wide exemption. The same 2021 revision cut the public comment period from 60 days to 15 working days, in the name of an ease of doing business act; applications and biosafety permits for commercial propagation and direct use are still required to be posted publicly on the NCBP and Bureau of Plant Industry websites.
